lines: Funding for projects
Learn about funding opportunities for nonprofits and developers working on affordable housing, community infrastructure and public service projects.
Find funding applications, funding requirements and required forms. Subscribe to this page to get updates.
Applications

Marin Affordable Housing Fund Funding for developers and nonprofits to support the development and preservation of affordable housing units throughout Marin. Applications are accepted throughout the year.
Measure W Community Housing Fund Funding for nonprofits to support housing and assistance programs in the Measure W Tax Area of West Marin. Applications are accepted throughout the year.
Notice of funding availability (NOFA) Towards the beginning of each calendar year, we open a funding application for affordable housing, community infrastructure and services projects.
Guidelines and requirements
Marin Affordable Housing Fund Learn about funding priorities and requirements for the County's Affordable Housing Fund.
Measure W Community Housing Fund Learn about funding priorities and requirements for Measure W funds.
Federal grants Learn about funding priorities and requirements for Community Development Block Grants (CDBG) and HOME Investment Partnerships Program (HOME).
Permanent Local Housing Allocation (PLHA) PLHA provides funding to local governments for housing-related projects and programs that assist in addressing the unmet housing needs.
Information for grantees
Affirmative marketing Learn more about the affirmative marketing requirement and how to create your plan.
Reporting requirements If you received funds, get information about your reporting requirements.
Our reports
Consolidated Plan We update the Consolidated Plan every 5 years to lay out strategies and priorities for addressing the needs of the County’s low-income population.
Annual Action Plan We submit this report every year to summarize how federal funds will be used to address specific goals.
Consolidated Annual Performance Evaluation Report (CAPER) We submit the CAPER every year to report on our annual performance.
Investing in Marin's Affordable Housing Tracking funds committed for housing development and preservation.
Related
Housing and Grants
The Housing and Community Investments Division expands and improves housing options in Marin County through policy and funding.
Additional funding sources
There are a number of other local, state and federal funding sources dedicated towards affordable housing.
Priority Setting Committee
The Countywide Priority Setting Committee helps the County prioritize federal and state money for affordable housing and public services.
